crew_permission_allow_bypass_hint: Hint of the Allow Bypass crew setting: what turning it off does
crew_permission_allow_bypass_label: Label of the crew setting that allows or forbids the Bypass mode
crew_permission_allow_once: Primary button of the approval prompt: allows this one call
crew_permission_allow_once_title: Tooltip of the Allow once button with its shortcut
crew_permission_allow_task: Button of the approval prompt: allows the same kind of call for the rest of this task only
crew_permission_answered_denied: Line left in the chat after the user denied a call
crew_permission_answered_once: Line left in the chat after the user allowed one call
crew_permission_answered_task: Line left in the chat after the user allowed a kind of call for the task
crew_permission_applies_next: Said in the mode menu and after a switch while the crewmate is working
crew_permission_badge_label: Accessible name of the small mode badge in the chat header and the crewmate list
crew_permission_comment_label: Label of the optional note field in the approval prompt; the note reaches the agent
crew_permission_comment_placeholder: Placeholder of the optional note in the approval prompt
crew_permission_default_hint: Hint of the default mode crew setting
crew_permission_default_label: Label of the crew setting that sets the permission mode a new crewmate starts in
crew_permission_deny: Button of the approval prompt: refuses the call
crew_permission_deny_title: Tooltip of the Deny button with its shortcut
crew_permission_fixed_reason: Shown next to the mode of a crewmate whose engine cannot ask (Codex, OpenCode); the mode cannot be changed
crew_permission_hint_ask: One line under the Ask mode in the mode menu
crew_permission_hint_bypass: One line under the Bypass mode in the mode menu
crew_permission_hint_edits: One line under the Accept edits mode in the mode menu
crew_permission_mode_ask: Name of the crewmate permission mode where every tool call waits for an answer
crew_permission_mode_bypass: Name of the permission mode that lets a crewmate run every tool call without asking (shown in amber)
crew_permission_mode_edits: Name of the permission mode that lets a crewmate edit files in its work tree without asking
crew_permission_picker_label: Accessible name of the mode button in the chat composer
crew_permission_rail_no_auto: Line in the approval prompt when the task source forced the question
crew_permission_rail_protected_path: Line in the approval prompt when a protected path forced the question
crew_permission_settings_mode: Label of the mode row in the crewmate settings dialog
crew_permission_settings_mode_hint: Hint of the mode row in the crewmate settings dialog
